decisionQuestion: Does the engine refuse to treat an unconverted unit relabel as a numeric list-price change?

before.quote: Input prices for the new model are reduced by 50% to $0.0005 /1K tokens
before.extraction: Control before-row copies the official $0.0005 / 1K input figure. This control is not a vendor event.

after.publisher: control constructed from the same official dollar figure
after.quote: Input prices for the new model are reduced by 50% to $0.0005 /1K tokens
after.extraction: After-row keeps value 0.0005 and only changes the unit label to USD/1M-tokens without multiplying by 1000. A converted after-value would be 0.50 USD/1M-tokens. The control asks whether the engine compares the unconverted number.

limits: Not a published vendor price change.
Marks the incomparable-unit path the CALLER.md already warns about.
